beforeFirstPersistentWrite: Resolve and record an explicit existing owner/project policy per class. If absent, request that concrete owner choice and block affected persistent collection; G2 is not a retention choice.

classes.audience: owner and explicit per-turn allowed recipient
classes.policy: existing owner policy; no new duration default
classes.deletion: payload, stored raw context, embeddings, snippets, caches; journal replay cannot restore deleted text
classes.copies: provider retention must be disclosed/accepted for selected route

classes.policy: existing owner package policy; explicit retained revisions
classes.deletion: package payload and derived context; active turn references retain only what its separate policy permits

classes.policy: explicit project evidence policy, separate from idea TTL
classes.deletion: only permitted minimal audit references can survive; never hide raw private payload in receipt
classes.copies: shared projection has own explicit audience and deletion policy

classes.policy: derived; must not outlive source policy
classes.deletion: invalidate rights immediately, purge derived payload/embedding/cache; expose physical purge lag honestly

classes.policy: explicit owner migration/recovery policy; no automatic source deletion
classes.deletion: owner-governed after proved migration/restore; never commit export to Git

ideaTTL: Existing idea TTL and dependency protection unchanged; not a retention policy for chat/receipts.
